$comment: High/critical advisories reviewed and temporarily accepted by scripts/audit-check.mjs. Each entry expires; after that date CI fails again until it is re-reviewed. Only add advisories that cannot reach the shipped web bundle and have no patched version.

exceptions.reason: Build-time only (metro-file-map > micromatch > braces); not in the browser bundle. DoS needs attacker-controlled glob patterns, which the build never takes. No patched version published yet.
Build-time only (@expo/cli > @expo/code-signing-certificates); not in the browser bundle. The app never verifies RSA signatures. No patched version published yet.
